description: Clean-room PyTorch gravitational waveform modeling library with literature provenance and explicitly scoped LALSimulation oracle verification; full catalog parity is unmet.

precessing_and_hm_tolerance.role: diagnostic reference only; does not replace direct complex, norm, or mismatch gates

global_conventions.polarizations: Complex Fourier strain h_plus(f) and h_cross(f) in physical geometric units (G/c^2 / distance)
global_conventions.time_translation: Strictly linear Fourier time shift: h(f; tc) = h(f; 0) * exp(-2*pi*i*f*tc)
global_conventions.reference_phasing: Aligned such that at reference frequency f_ref, SPA phase convention satisfies Psi(f_ref) = 3*pi/4 (LAL convention) or 0 (pure reference convention)

TaylorF2.name: TaylorF2

pn_orders.spin_order: Up to 7 (3.5PN spin-orbit, spin-spin, and self-spin)
pn_orders.tidal_order: Up to 13 (6.5PN electric quadrupole and octupole tides)

TaylorF2.notes: Strict CPU FP64 parity passed only on the 4 declared TaylorF2 cases. Both polarizations have complex relative L2 < 1.64e-12; the six detector/sky projections per case have complex relative L2 < 3.08e-7. These measurements do not certify the full parameter domain. Evidence: docs/reviews/2026-09-11-agy/verification/strict-catalog.json.

direct_fp64_parity.scope: maximum over both polarizations of declared cases; detector projections recorded separately

primary_references.citation: Buonanno, Iyer, Ochsner, Pan, Sathyaprakash (2009), Phys. Rev. D 80, 084043
Mishra, Kaviraj, Arun (2016), Phys. Rev. D 93, 084039
Vines, Flanagan, Hinderer (2011), Phys. Rev. D 83, 084051

IMRPhenomD.name: IMRPhenomD
IMRPhenomD.notes: Partial parity against LALSimulation IMRPhenomD. Diagnostic catalog verification configuration yields plus magnitude relative L2 error 0.0014835; full strict direct complex L2 <= 1e-6 gate is unmet.

primary_references.citation: Husa et al. (2016), Phys. Rev. D 93, 044006
Khan et al. (2016), Phys. Rev. D 93, 044007
Berti, Cardoso, Will (2006), Phys. Rev. D 73, 064030

IMRPhenomPv2.name: IMRPhenomPv2
IMRPhenomPv2.frame_convention: P-frame precession angle twisting via single effective precession parameter chi_p
IMRPhenomPv2.notes: Partial parity against LALSimulation IMRPhenomPv2. Uses single-effective-spin twisting approximation; diagnostic catalog configuration yields plus magnitude relative L2 error 0.1182047, strict direct complex L2 <= 1e-6 gate is unmet.

primary_references.citation: Hannam et al. (2014), Phys. Rev. Lett. 113, 151101
Schmidt et al. (2015), Phys. Rev. D 91, 024043

IMRPhenomXP.name: IMRPhenomXP
IMRPhenomXP.frame_convention: Multispin P-frame twisting angles with NNLO spin-orbit angles (Chatziioannou et al. 2017, Pratten et al. 2021)
IMRPhenomXP.notes: Partial parity against LALSimulation IMRPhenomXP. 4th-generation precessing model using Pratten et al. (2021) angles; diagnostic catalog configuration yields plus magnitude relative L2 error 0.1177515, strict direct complex L2 <= 1e-6 gate is unmet.

primary_references.citation: Pratten et al. (2021), Phys. Rev. D 103, 104056

IMRPhenomHM.name: IMRPhenomHM
IMRPhenomHM.frame_convention: Co-orbital to radiation frame SWSH projection with London et al. (2018) mode mixing
IMRPhenomHM.notes: Partial parity against LALSimulation IMRPhenomHM. Multipolar model with SWSH projection; diagnostic catalog configuration yields plus magnitude relative L2 error 0.1973065, strict direct complex L2 <= 1e-6 gate is unmet.

primary_references.citation: London et al. (2018), Phys. Rev. Lett. 120, 161102

IMRPhenomXHM.name: IMRPhenomXHM
IMRPhenomXHM.frame_convention: García-Quirós et al. (2020) spherical harmonic decomposition and collocation reconstruction
IMRPhenomXHM.notes: Partial parity against LALSimulation IMRPhenomXHM. Multipolar approximant built on native IMRPhenomXAS carrier; diagnostic catalog configuration yields plus magnitude relative L2 error 0.1164806, strict direct complex L2 <= 1e-6 gate is unmet.

primary_references.citation: García-Quirós et al. (2020), Phys. Rev. D 102, 064002
Pratten et al. (2020), Phys. Rev. D 102, 064001

IMRPhenomXPHM.name: IMRPhenomXPHM
IMRPhenomXPHM.frame_convention: Time-dependent Wigner-D rotation from coprecessing frame to inertial detector frame (Pratten et al. 2021)
IMRPhenomXPHM.notes: Partial parity against LALSimulation IMRPhenomXPHM. 4th-generation precessing higher-multipole model; diagnostic catalog configuration yields plus magnitude relative L2 error 0.1067059, strict direct complex L2 <= 1e-6 gate is unmet.

primary_references.citation: Pratten et al. (2021), Phys. Rev. D 103, 104056
García-Quirós et al. (2020), Phys. Rev. D 102, 064002

IMRPhenomXAS.name: IMRPhenomXAS
IMRPhenomXAS.notes: Clean-room aligned-spin model using author-released version 104 fits and an analytic inspiral amplitude boundary derivative. The catalog case has plus magnitude relative L2 0.0974379 and component-optimized match 0.9960015; strict direct complex parity remains unmet. The derivative tests do not establish continuity of the complete piecewise amplitude or parameter-domain parity.

primary_references.citation: Pratten et al. (2020), Phys. Rev. D 102, 064001
Mathematica public release candidate: IMRPhenomXAS_Parameter_Space_Fits_Public_Release_Candidate.m
